answer: Locks are logged in fable, expire in saffron, and harbor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 25 aliases therefore needs 173 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3064 identities would post 4721 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
